title: Introduce tiered prefill cost-prober and quant annealer
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds a lightweight cost-prober daemon and a tiered prefill router plus an offline quant annealer that synthesizes conservative quantization profiles from sampled traces. Motivation: teams need safer, automated defaults for batching/prefill/quant that respect latency SLOs while reducing unit cost. This PR introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) cost-prober service that runs periodic microbenchmarks across available model variants and sequence-length distributions to produce per-model latency/cost fingerprints; 2) a tiered prefill router that classifies incoming requests into latency-sensitive and cost-sensitive paths and applies different prefill and batch-windowing policies; 3) an offline quant annealer that consumes prober traces and generates candidate quantization presets with conservative quality constraints. The changeset includes a new feature flag (econ.tiered_prefill_enabled), a CLI tool to run the prober locally, new metrics (econ.prober.latency_ms, econ.prefill.path_rate, econ.quant.quality_estimate), example default presets added to config/defaults/econ-presets.yaml, and a docs page with rollout guidance. Design notes: the prober intentionally uses short, isolated runs to avoid polluting production caches; tiered router falls back to current single-path behavior when feature flag is off; quant annealer outputs only recommended profiles that must be accepted via API or Console. Performance: in internal canary on a 4-card A10 pool we observe median per-token cost reduction of ~11% for chat-like workloads with 0.5% output divergence measured on eval prompt set; cold-start tail latency increased <2% for the latency-sensitive path. Rollout plan: gated feature-flag, stage canary window, metrics-based rollback alerts. Tests: unit tests for router heuristics, integration test that runs a short prober trace and validates profiles are produced, e2e smoke verifying fallback behavior. Related: ENG-4321 rollout plan and ENG-4380 quant safety thresholds. See docs/cost-optimization/tiered-prefill.md for operational runbook.
